name: hey
description: Hey — dating app. Single deploy: builds web, copies into backend/public, runs Nest as one Node process serving API + WS + SPA.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix web run build && rm -rf backend/public && mkdir -p backend/public && cp -r web/dist/* backend/public/
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:web && npm run build:backend
